scene:
A man sitting upright with his eyes closed, seen from the chest up, and all around his body a doughnut-shaped field drawn as bright gold glowing electrified lines pouring up out of his chest, over his head, down around him and back in underneath. Small black dots travel along those gold lines like beads running on a wire. There is no anatomical heart and no organ visible — the centre of the field is simply where the lines converge in his chest.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A close view of a man's chest and shoulders, head mostly out of frame. Curving over his heart is one side only of an oval cage — a single curved panel of widely spaced bars, not a whole enclosure and not shut, the gaps between the bars clearly open. The bars are drawn as thick white glowing light with a cool bluish tinge, never warm or yellow. Held inside behind them, a faint luminous shape pressed close against his chest.

No text or lettering anywhere.

The same close view of a man's chest with the same curved panel of white-blue glowing bars over his heart, but now the lines have gone slack and drifted apart — wider, softer, sagging away from each other so they no longer hold anything. Nothing has swung open and there is no door and no hinge; the lines have simply loosened. The luminous shape behind them is beginning to rise free.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A dark bedroom seen from above and behind, a sleeping man on the bed, and on the floor beside the bed three large black shapes. Each shape is a smooth heavy dome, rounded and solid on top and taking up real space in the room, with short crab-like legs showing only underneath at the very bottom edge where it meets the floor. The domes are big — each about the size of a crouching dog.

No text or lettering anywhere.
